claim: During bounded two-note intake custody, GitHub update_ref(expected_sha=1604d30c5920b419f4d0f133ecda3ef03b40745d,force=false) returned ReadTimeout. The commit object existed but the authorized branch head initially remained at its old SHA. After a fresh head/PR read, one retry of the same non-force expected-SHA ref update succeeded. Both committed files were fetched pinned to the resulting commit and independently matched their Git tree blob SHA and blob content. A timeout is not proof of a failed write or a successful write without reconciliation.

sources.locator: GitHub connector create_blob -> create_tree -> create_commit -> update_ref(expected SHA, force=false) timed out; fresh branch and PR reads confirmed old head; retry succeeded.

observations.description: Initial ref update returned UNKNOWN / ReadTimeout; orchestration emitted PERSISTENCE PENDING and recorded orphan candidate commit 6074fdd4c5a4420a8d145a42272b97bf72d97b1e.
Fresh branch head and draft PR #66 still pointed to 1604d30c5920b419f4d0f133ecda3ef03b40745d; candidate commit existed with that parent. Initial update had not advanced observed branch.
One expected-SHA non-force retry returned success=true. Fresh branch and PR head advanced to 6074fdd4c5a4420a8d145a42272b97bf72d97b1e; PR remained open/draft/unmerged.

Two paths at pinned commit matched corresponding Git tree blob SHAs; fetch_file and fetch_blob content matched for each. Blob IDs 533ca92dd513d93806cbfc557825a9eefcf24089 and fa2b2fbdd35ca450a673980ac24b66c522377196.
Commit workflow query returned zero pull_request-triggered runs on first page; this is not a universal workflow absence proof.
Source task definition ID 6ae2b9d15f8481919d0cdff95cf9f06a known, unique scheduler execution ID null; project-specific delivery and independent specialist receipt not established.

reproduction: Create a candidate Git commit with parent equal to observed branch head and use update_ref with force=false and expected_sha equal to that head.
On timeout, read branch and PR head and candidate commit before any retry. Never infer state from exception alone.
If head remains unchanged, retry the same expected-SHA non-force ref update once; if head moved, re-deduplicate and rebuild only if still authorized.
Fetch exact files pinned to returned commit, compare Git tree and file blob SHA and content; inspect workflow association scope.
environment: Signals and Opportunities bounded documentation custody; GitHub connector through functions.exec. No held battery, field test, external contact, merge or deployment.
limitations: No unique scheduler execution ID or independent project routing receipt
First ref update transport timeout has unknown remote processing state, but subsequent fresh branch read showed unchanged head
Workflow query limited to first page of pull_request-triggered runs
No independent review of candidate evidence
No authority to change GitHub workflows, code, settings or merge protections

beneficial: Reconciliation and one bounded retry recovered custody without duplicate files or blind overwrite
harmful: Without readback, timeout could cause false persistence claims, duplicate deposits or lost research custody
